tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Render a URL, raw HTML or Markdown in a real Chrome and capture it as an image (returned inline), PDF, GIF or video (returned as a link). Set block_cookie_banners and block_ads for a clean capture. For a full_page capture to read, keep it small with image_width (e.g. 1024) and format jpg.

tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Load a URL in a real browser (JavaScript runs) and return its content as Markdown, without scripts and styles. Use selector (e.g. main, article) to keep only the part that matters and save tokens.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "screenshot" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
